title: Atelier Rule on Production Time, Holds and Expedited Work
content:
# Atelier Rule on Production Time, Holds and Expedited Work

Production on a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions runs to the programme's lead time in business days, counted from the day the deposit cleared, and the promised delivery date is set from that lead time. A production stage is recorded only while the commission stands in production, on hold or awaiting final payment, and each stage is recorded once. Expedited production is promised only where the customer gave at least the programme's minimum notice in calendar days, and it carries the programme's surcharge on the quoted total. A commission held up sits on hold for no longer than the programme allows; past that the studio treats it as closed and the cancellation terms apply as they stand on that day. The finished piece is checked and, under the programmes that require it, signed off by the customer before it leaves the studio.

## Recording a stage of production

A production stage is recorded against the commission only while the commission record shows it standing in production, on hold or awaiting final payment, and each stage is recorded once. The stage the commission stands at is read from the commission record, correlated by its commission reference, before the production stage is recorded.

## Expediting

| Element | Basis |
|---|---|
| Notice | At least the programme's minimum notice in calendar days before the commission is expedited |
| Surcharge | The programme's expediting surcharge as a percentage of the quoted total |
| Production time | The programme's expedited production time in business days, in place of its ordinary lead time |

*Both sides of the notice requirement (hypothetical).* Under a programme whose minimum notice is 21 calendar days, notice given 21 calendar days ahead satisfies the requirement, and notice given 20 calendar days ahead does not.

## Holds

A commission held up sits on hold for no longer than the programme allows in calendar days. Past that the studio treats the commission as closed, and the cancellation terms apply as they stand on that day.

## Before the piece leaves the studio

The finished piece is checked, and under the programmes that require it the customer signs it off before it leaves the studio.
